title: Hearty Spicy Jamaican Chicken Stew
description: A dense and spicy stew featuring HP sauce, perfect for a monsoon day, this kosher-friendly dish is a twist on traditional Jamaican cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the HP sauce, thyme, allspice, and chicken broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes and continue to simmer for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
